title: Compact-object and Ind duality for a fixed accessibility rank
statement: Let $\lambda\in\mathcal U$ be an uncountable regular cardinal. Let $\operatorname{Pr}^{\mathrm L,\lambda}_\infty$ be the subcategory of the infinity category of $\mathcal U'$-small infinity categories whose objects are the presentable infinity categories that are $\lambda$-accessible and whose morphisms are the coherent functors preserving small colimits and $\lambda$-compact objects, and let $\operatorname{Pr}^{\mathrm R,\lambda}_\infty$ be the subcategory with the same objects whose morphisms are the coherent functors admitting a left adjoint and preserving small $\lambda$-filtered colimits. (1) For objects $\mathcal C,\mathcal D$ and an adjunction $L:\mathcal C\rightleftarrows\mathcal D:R$, the functor $L$ preserves $\lambda$-compact objects if and only if $R$ preserves small $\lambda$-filtered colimits; every functor between objects preserving small colimits has a right adjoint. (2) There is an equivalence $\operatorname{Pr}^{\mathrm L,\lambda}_\infty\simeq(\operatorname{Pr}^{\mathrm R,\lambda}_\infty)^{\mathrm{op}}$ which is the identity on objects and carries each morphism $L$ to a right adjoint of $L$; hence for every small infinity category $S$, coherent diagrams $S\to\operatorname{Pr}^{\mathrm L,\lambda}_\infty$ correspond, up to equivalence, to coherent diagrams $S^{\mathrm{op}}\to\operatorname{Pr}^{\mathrm R,\lambda}_\infty$ with the same values, each arrow being sent to a right adjoint of it. (3) Let $\operatorname{Cat}^{\mathrm{rex}(\lambda)}_\infty$ be the infinity category of small infinity categories admitting $\lambda$-small colimits, with functors preserving these colimits. Then $\operatorname{Ind}_\lambda$ of [lem-coef-ind-kappa-presentability], sending $C$ to $\operatorname{Ind}_\lambda(C)$ and $u:C\to D$ to the extension of $C\xrightarrow{u}D\xrightarrow{j}\operatorname{Ind}_\lambda(D)$ preserving small $\lambda$-filtered colimits, is an equivalence of infinity categories $\operatorname{Cat}^{\mathrm{rex}(\lambda)}_\infty\to\operatorname{Pr}^{\mathrm L,\lambda}_\infty$. A quasi-inverse sends $\mathcal C$ to a small infinity category equivalent to the full subcategory $\mathcal C^\lambda$ of $\lambda$-compact objects of $\mathcal C$ and a morphism to its restriction to $\lambda$-compact objects, and the Yoneda embedding identifies $C$ with $\operatorname{Ind}_\lambda(C)^\lambda$. Being equivalences of infinity categories, these equivalences act on coherent diagrams including all higher simplices. The universes, compactness, accessibility and presentability used here are those of [def-coef-presentable-infinity-category], and adjunctions, coherent functors and subcategories are those of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones].
